description: This script extracts factory data specific to the Predator W6 device, handling MMC partition identification, mounting, copying MAC address data, and cleanup. It is invoked during the pre-initialization phase based on the board name.

methods.name: predator_w6_factory_extract
methods.description: Extracts factory data for the Predator W6 device by mounting specific MMC partition and copying MAC address files.

methods.name: preinit_extract_factory
methods.description: Calls the device-specific factory extraction function if the board name matches 'acer,predator-w6'.
